bounds.quote: Take a staggered stance, hinge until the torso is long and stable, and let the kettlebell hang beneath one shoulder. bounds.quote: Take an underhand grip just outside the thighs, soften the knees, and hinge until the bar hangs below them with the torso braced. bounds.quote: Straddle the bar, hinge to about 45 degrees, and take the handle with a neutral grip.
